description: A curated vocabulary for the committed Movies snapshot. All stored relationship types are covered; CreativeWork is a broader concept used for classification.

Person.description: A human individual represented in the movie dataset. Having this kind alone does not mean the person acted in a film.
Person.label: Person
Person.titleMeaning: The display name of the person.

CreativeWork.description: A created work, such as a film. This example declares the concept without storing any node directly under this kind.
CreativeWork.label: Creative work

Movie.description: A motion picture represented in the dataset.
Movie.label: Movie

ACTED_IN.description: A person performed in a movie. The roles belong to this particular person-to-movie relationship.
ACTED_IN.label: acted in

roles.description: Names of the characters played by this person in this movie.

WROTE.description: A person wrote a screenplay for a movie.
WROTE.label: wrote

REVIEWED.description: A person reviewed a movie, with the review stored on the relationship.
REVIEWED.label: reviewed

rating.description: The numeric rating recorded by the source dataset; this profile does not impose a rating scale.

FOLLOWS.description: A person follows another person. A reverse reading does not imply that the other person follows them back.
FOLLOWS.label: follows
